in_sanskrit.name: जन्मेजय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जनन् (janan) meaning 'birth' and मेजय (mejay) meaning 'lord' or 'ruler'. So, Janmejay means 'Born of the people' or 'Lord of the people'.

in_hindi.name: जन्मेजय
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, Janmejay is derived from the Sanskrit words जनन (janan) meaning 'birth' and मेजय (mejay) meaning 'lord' or 'ruler'. So, Janmejay can be interpreted as 'Born of the people' or 'Lord of the people'. Another interpretation is 'Sun of the people', represented by the Hindi name जननादित्य (jananaditya).

in_tamil.name: ஜன்மேஜய்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Janmejay is derived from the Sanskrit words जनन (janan) meaning 'birth' and मेजय (mejay) meaning 'lord' or 'ruler'. In Tamil, the name is written as ஜன்மேஜய், which can be interpreted as 'People's born' or 'Lord of the people'.

in_telugu.name: జన్మేజేయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Janmejay is derived from the Sanskrit words जनन (janan) meaning 'birth' and मेजय (mejay) meaning 'lord' or 'ruler'. In Telugu, the name is written as జన్మేజేయ, which can be interpreted as 'Born of the people' or 'Lord of the people'. Another interpretation is 'Lord of the people's domain', represented by the Telugu name జననదేశ్ (jananadesam).

The name holds a deep spiritual significance, symbolizing divine descent, royal lineage, and a strong connection to the divine.
